start.text: Well, well. A new face. I'm Riko. I assist the building manager. You look... interesting.

flirt.text: Bold. I like bold. Most people here are so... tame. You don't seem tame.

choices.text: I'm whatever you want me to be.
I could be tamed. By the right person.

business.text: The building has many amenities. Some... not advertised. Come see me if you want the full tour.

choices.text: I'm interested. What's the full tour?

manager.text: Aoi. She runs everything. The club, the tenants, the... special services. You'll meet her soon enough.

club_hint.text: Let's just say... some residents have needs. Aoi fulfills them. For a price. Or for loyalty.

choices.text: I might be interested in that.

tour_offer.text: Good. Meet me in the basement tonight. 10 PM. Don't be late. And... dress appropriately.

dress.text: Something you wouldn't mind getting... removed. Trust me.

tease.text: Maybe I am. Maybe I'm not. You'll find out tonight.

dominant.text: I thought so. I like someone who can take charge. Or be taken. Which is it for you?

submissive.text: A willing submissive. Rare and precious. I could teach you things... if you're ready.

dom_path.text: Then you'll need a partner who can handle you. Lucky for you, I can. Come to my apartment tonight.

sub_path.text: Good. Kneel for me. Right here, right now. Let's see how obedient you can be.

switch_path.text: A switch. The best kind. Someone who can give and take. I think we'll get along very well.
